previous_defect.proof: Current generated mesh under the Swissôtel ring contained only the approximately 32.19 m mall roof and low terrain. No 226 m tower was present. All old stands were at least 105 m from the expected near-side Stamford region; no existing stand geometry covered it.

tower_controls.name: Swissôtel The Stamford
tower_controls.curved_front: The first twelve mapped points are resampled at about 2 m spacing by angular/radial interpolation about their fitted circle. Maximum departure from the original coarse mapped chords is 0.515 m. Flat rear edges are unchanged. This is a rounded architectural reconstruction within approximately 1 m map uncertainty, not a surveyed circular footprint.

tower_controls.name: Fairmont Singapore
tower_controls.geometry: Actual multi-wing mapped part, with recessed windows and balcony bands. No bounding rectangle replaces its concavities.

tower_controls.name: Raffles City Tower
tower_controls.geometry: Actual chamfered mapped office outline with dark glazing and gray horizontal/vertical framing.

podium.method: Use the existing mall facade foundation: minimum existing ground at its retained ring. All three part heights are total heights above this same ground datum. Upper structures start at min_height 30 m, rather than adding 226/88/158 m above the podium. Existing raw DSM at the Swissôtel center is approximately 10.15 m and is not used as a second foundation.
podium.terrain_treatment: No district flattening. The existing mall remains intact and encloses its original occupied terrain; only the temporary stand footprint gets an adjacent-road-level pad.

facade_estimates.note: Bay rhythm, crown heights and glazing distribution are reconstructed from owner exterior and supplied night views. Existing White/Concrete/Glass/WarmGlass materials are used. No new importer/material behavior.

temporary_stand.name: Stamford Grandstand
temporary_stand.foundation_method: Adjacent canonical road at the two estimated ends, averaged and raised 0.12 m. Only the exact 1701 m² occupied terrace pad replaces DSM vegetation relief. This temporary stand footprint is estimated from primary event-map location and direct forward reference, not an OSM building survey.
temporary_stand.vegetation: The existing tree lattice, heights and seeds in 1390.38–1948.27 m are retained, excluding roots within 2 m of this stand. No additional tree rows are invented.

physical_changes: None. Road XYZ, width, elevation, banking, camera, driving surfaces, barriers and pit profile remain unchanged.
